rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

companies.name: クニティ・エレクトロニクス

relations.text: 電子材料事業を分離した会社。移行サービス契約を結ぶ
relations.text_en: Its spun-off electronics business, under transition services agreements

source.label: Qnity Electronics 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: DuPont does not provide us with assistance other than the transition and other services described in the Transition Services Agreements.

relations.text: PFAS関連の保険金をめぐり覚書を締結(2025年8月)
relations.text_en: Signed a PFAS insurance proceeds MOU in August 2025

source.label: Chemours 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In August 2025, we, EID and the DuPont Indemnitees entered into a PFAS Insurance Proceeds Memorandum of Understanding ("PFAS Insurance MOU")

relations.text: 分離契約に基づき、訴訟・環境などの費用を分担
relations.text_en: Shares litigation and environmental costs with it under separation agreements

source.label: Corteva 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The company, pursuant to the respective Separation Agreements, is entitled to cost sharing and indemnification from The Chemours Company ("Chemours"), Dow and DuPont

companies.name: インターナショナル・フレーバー&フレグランス

relations.text: 栄養・バイオ事業(N&B)をIFFと統合し、税務契約を結ぶ
relations.text_en: Combined its Nutrition & Biosciences business with IFF under a tax matters agreement

source.label: IFF 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Under the Tax Matters Agreement, we and N&B will be required to indemnify DuPont for any taxes resulting from a Spinco Tainting Act.

relations.text: 高機能樹脂事業(M&M)をCelaneseに売却(2022年)
relations.text_en: Sold its Mobility & Materials business to Celanese (2022)

source.label: Celanese 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: pursuant to a definitive transaction agreement entered into in February 2022 by us, DuPont and an affiliate of DuPont (the "M&M Acquisition").

relations.text: Rogersの買収を目指したが中国の承認が得られず、2022年に合併契約を解除
relations.text_en: Agreed to buy Rogers but terminated the deal in 2022 without Chinese approval

source.label: Rogers 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: As of November 1, 2022, the parties had not received regulatory approval from State Administration for Market Regulation of China and on that date, DuPont de Nemours, Inc. issued a notice of termination of the merger agreement.

relations.text: 逆浸透膜メーカーを2025年10月に買収
relations.text_en: Acquired the reverse osmosis membrane maker in October 2025

source.label: DuPont 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On October 10, 2025, the Company completed the acquisition of Sinochem (Ningbo) RO Memtech Co., Ltd.

relations.text: 医療用部品メーカーを3.65億ドルで買収(2024年7月)
relations.text_en: Acquired the medical device components maker for $365 million (July 2024)

source.label: DuPont 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On July 28, 2024, DuPont completed the acquisition of Donatelle Plastics, LLC ("Donatelle"), for a net purchase price of $365 million

companies.name: スペクトラム・プラスチックス

source.label: DuPont 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On August 1, 2023, the Company completed the acquisition of Spectrum Plastics Group ("Spectrum") from AEA Investors.

companies.name: アルファ・プロ・テック

relations.text: Alpha Pro Techが10-Kで、住宅用防水シートの主な競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Alpha Pro Tech names DuPont a major housewrap competitor

source.label: Alpha Pro Tech 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our major competitors in the construction supply weatherization market are DuPont and Berry Global for housewrap and Owens Corning and GAF for synthetic roof underlayment.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
